evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
evidence_tree.limitation: The scenario definition for 'cleaver_bloodsong_roster' does not exist anywhere under data/ (grep for 'cleaver_bloodsong' and 'coupled_scenarios' across the export returns nothing). The absolute inputs (champions, levels, ranks, target armor, event ledger) were therefore NOT available. The computation below is a ratio/identity proof against sourced constants, not an absolute re-derivation from inputs.

sources_quoted.quote: After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).

Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.

sources_quoted.note: Independently confirms the parsed Expose Weakness pair as (8 percent, 5 percent) in melee-then-ranged text order, plus the 4 s duration and 1.5 s cooldown.

sources_quoted.source: data/items.json — corroboration of the {{rd|melee|ranged}} template convention from items whose live values are unambiguous
sources_quoted.quote: Tiamat / Ravenous Hydra / Stridebreaker Cleave: '{{rd|40% AD|20% AD}}'; Titanic Hydra Cleave: '{{rd|1%|{{fd|0.5}}%}} maximum health'; Blade of the Ruined King Mist's Edge: '{{rd|9%|6%}} of the target's current health'
sources_quoted.note: In every case the FIRST argument is the melee value and the SECOND is the ranged value. Hence Bloodsong's Expose Weakness is 8% for a melee holder, 5% for a ranged holder.

sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md, Section 2.3 item 2 (Black Cleaver average stacks)
sources_quoted.quote: the exact Cesaro mean of the capped ramp min(k, C) over h hits is C - C(C-1)/(2h) for h >= C; the constant model equals the exact mean at ~10 autos and deviates by up to +/-20% at the extremes

sources_quoted.source: data/items.json — exhaustive sweep of every item passive/active branch containing 'increased damage'
sources_quoted.quote: Only two cached items expose an 8% flat damage amplifier: Bloodsong ('{{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources') and Riftmaker ('2% increased damage, stacking up to 4 times for a total of 8% increased damage'). Riftmaker is not named in the scenario; Bloodsong is.

step_1_observed_multiplier.reasoning: Golden leaves are stored to one decimal, so old in [94.05, 94.15) and new in [101.65, 101.75). The true multiplier m = new/old therefore lies in [101.65/94.15, 101.75/94.05].
step_1_observed_multiplier.note: The change is a pure scalar on a single late event; the band is tight (+/-0.11%).

step_2_candidate_hypotheses.hypothesis: H1 - Bloodsong 'Expose Weakness' damage amplifier applied (melee holder, 8%)
step_2_candidate_hypotheses.self_consistency_check: Let B be the un-amplified event damage. B * 1.08 rounds to 101.7 iff B in [94.1204, 94.1667]. Every B in that interval rounds to 94.1. So old = 94.1 and new = 101.7 are simultaneously consistent with a single underlying B ~ 94.13-94.16 and an exact x1.08 amp. Worked example: B = 94.14 -> 94.14 * 1.08 = 101.6712 -> 101.7.

step_2_candidate_hypotheses.hypothesis: H2 - Bloodsong 'Expose Weakness' applied at the RANGED value (5%)
step_2_candidate_hypotheses.verdict: Ruled out as an explanation of the observed pair.

step_2_candidate_hypotheses.hypothesis: H3 - Black Cleaver 'Carve' armor-reduction model changed (e.g. constant 0.8*max_stacks -> exact Cesaro mean, per S6)
step_2_candidate_hypotheses.computation: With m(R) = 100/(100+R) (S5) and Carve at 6% per stack up to 30% (S2), the multiplier from a reduction change r_old -> r_new against base armor A is (100 + A*(1-r_old)) / (100 + A*(1-r_new)). Even the extreme jump 24% -> 30% (4 stacks -> 5 stacks) yields only 1.025 at A=60, 1.031 at A=80, 1.035 at A=100, 1.039 at A=120; solving (100+0.76A)/(100+0.70A) = 1.0808 requires A ~ 2327 armor, which no champion has. The Cesaro-mean correction is even smaller (it moves the mean from 4.0 to at most 5.0 stacks, and only upward once h > 10 hits).
step_2_candidate_hypotheses.structural_argument: Additionally the leaf is events[28] - at least 29 damage events deep. Carve saturates at 5 stacks after 5 physical hits and refreshes on a 6 s window, so BOTH the old and the new model necessarily sit at max stacks by event 28; the stack-count model cannot differ there at all.

step_2_candidate_hypotheses.verdict: Numerically indistinguishable from H1, but Riftmaker is not one of the two items the scenario is named for, and it is an AP-line item; H1 is the only amplifier sourced to an item actually named in the scenario (S7).

step_3_conclusion.identified_mechanic: Bloodsong 'Expose Weakness': target takes 8% increased damage from ALL sources for 4 s (melee holder), 1.5 s internal cooldown starting after the empowered attack.
step_3_conclusion.reconstructed_value: B * 1.08 with B in [94.121, 94.167] (the interval of un-amplified values that display as 94.1) -> 101.65..101.70 -> displays as 101.7

residual_assumption.statement: The 8% branch is correct only if the Bloodsong holder in this roster is a MELEE champion; a ranged holder is sourced at 5% (S1/S4) and the correct leaf would then be ~98.8, making both values wrong.
residual_assumption.why_it_was_not_verifiable: The roster composition is defined outside data/ (in the corpus/scenario code this investigation is forbidden to read).
residual_assumption.why_the_verdict_still_stands: The observed multiplier reproduces a sourced constant exactly (1.08, the melee branch of {{rd|8%|5%}}) to within display rounding, while the old value corresponds to the amplifier being absent entirely - not to the 5% branch. An engine that had picked the wrong branch of the rd pair would have produced 98.8, not 101.7. The new value is therefore the one that matches a value literally present in the cached wiki text for an item the scenario is named after.

verdict_detail.confidence: high on the mechanic and the multiplier; medium-high on the melee/ranged branch (see residual_assumption)
verdict_detail.old_value_diagnosis: 94.1 is the un-amplified damage - Bloodsong's Expose Weakness amplifier was not being applied to this event.
